description.value: Dining Wok Shanghai Restaurant is a casual dine-in Chinese restaurant in White Rock specializing in Sichuan, Peking, and Shanghai cuisine. The relaxed, family-friendly atmosphere makes it a comfortable stop for a sit-down meal. Online ordering is available for those who prefer takeout.

address.value: 15246 Russell Ave, White Rock, BC V4B 2P6

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is available and confirms the OSM name, address, and cuisine. The site advertises online ordering, indicating takeout is available. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) are mentioned anywhere in the website content or OSM tags, so those are null per evidence rules.
